title: MusicDrop v1.3.3 Available
changelog:
• DJ Overlap Mix (Next track starts & fades in before current track ends for continuous DJ mashup mix)
• Settings Switch: Toggle DJ Overlap Crossfade and Silence Trimming on/off anytime
• Premium Mini Player Seek Scrubber: Tap or drag to scrub forward/backward directly on the shrunk player bar with live time badge
• Offline Detection Fix: Instant startup offline banner and seamless playback from downloaded library
• Online Restoration Banner: Notifies when connection is restored to search and stream
